name: KD
pattern: /^        KD = lambda s, d: hash_utf8("%s:%s" % (s, d))$/

name: __init__
signature: (self, method=None, url=None, headers=None, files=None, data=None, params=None, auth=None, cookies=None, hooks=None, json=None)

name: cert_verify
pattern: /^    def cert_verify(self, conn, url, verify, cert):$/

name: get
pattern: /^    def get(self, name, default=None, domain=None, path=None):$/

name: get_proxy
pattern: /^    get_proxy = lambda k: os.environ.get(k) or os.environ.get(k.upper())$/

name: merge_environment_settings
pattern: /^    def merge_environment_settings(self, url, proxies, stream, verify, cert):$/

name: prepare
signature: (self, method=None, url=None, headers=None, files=None, data=None, params=None, auth=None, cookies=None, hooks=None, json=None)

name: request
signature: (self, method, url, params=None, data=None, headers=None, cookies=None, files=None, auth=None, timeout=None, allow_redirects=True, proxies=None, hooks=None, stream=None, verify=None, cert=None, json=None)

name: resolve_redirects
pattern: /^    def resolve_redirects(self, resp, req, stream=False, timeout=None,$/
signature: (self, resp, req, stream=False, timeout=None, verify=True, cert=None, proxies=None, yield_requests=False, **adapter_kwargs)

name: send
pattern: /^    def send(self, request, stream=False, timeout=None, verify=True, cert=None, proxies=None):$/
signature: (self, request, stream=False, timeout=None, verify=True, cert=None, proxies=None)

name: send
pattern: /^    def send(self, request, stream=False, timeout=None, verify=True,$/
signature: (self, request, stream=False, timeout=None, verify=True, cert=None, proxies=None)
